synopsis: The Offroad Autonomy Library is a commercial MathWorks support package for construction, mining and agriculture using Unreal Engine scenes; MATLAB/Simulink, the library and RoadRunner have per-product annual or perpetual licensing [f8374, f8958, f15877]. Its documented capabilities span an MPPI off-road planner available since R2024b, articulated-steering kinematics since R2025a, a vehicle-library loader since R2026b, and traversability analysis; R2026b is the second release of 2026 [f8375, f8376, f8377, f8378, f16239]. Vendor evidence includes shipped autonomous-excavator, backhoe truck-loading and open-pit haul-truck examples, but independent validation for automatic braking on heavy machines was not found [f15878, f8680, f8289]. The package exposes camera, lidar and INS, while radar and ultrasonic are listed in the wider stack rather than confirmed specifically inside the off-road package [f8380, f8960, f8382]. The proposed middle-cost engineering chain combines the MathWorks tools with Unreal and sensor toolboxes, with Mevea or AGX Dynamics coupled through FMI for terrain, hydraulics and machine variants [f9285, f16162].
